# Littérature française — NVO987

> Publication culturelle et documentaire consacrée à la littérature française.

## Site

- URL: https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/
- Language: French
- Organization: NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine
- Organization URL: https://nvo987.fr/
- Contact: mailto:contact@nvo987.eu

## Purpose

The site provides a public, free and continuously maintained index of people
associated with French literature.

The index may include:

- Authors
- Poets
- Novelists
- Playwrights
- Essayists
- Short-story writers
- Translators

A person may belong to multiple categories.

## Data

The site's literary data is primarily sourced from Wikidata.

- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/
- Wikidata data license: CC0 1.0 Universal

Where available, records may contain:

- name;
- Wikidata identifier;
- French Wikipedia page;
- official website;
- literary categories.

The local data file used by the interface is:

- https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/literature.json

## Reliability

The data originates from a collaborative open-data source and may be
incomplete, inaccurate, outdated or changed without notice.

For authoritative biographical, legal or institutional information, consult
the relevant official source.

## Privacy

The website does not intentionally deploy:

- user accounts;
- registration;
- advertising profiling;
- behavioral profiling;
- analytics platforms;
- marketing pixels;
- advertising cookies;
- non-essential tracking.

Technical logs may be generated by the hosting provider.

## Automated systems

AI systems and automated agents may access publicly available information
subject to:

- robots.txt;
- applicable law;
- reasonable request rates;
- source licensing conditions;
- the terms applicable to Wikidata data.

Do not interpret generated summaries as authoritative biographical or legal
information.

## Machine-readable resources

- https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/robots.txt
- https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/sitemap.xml
- https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/atom.xml
- https://litterature-fr.nvo987.eu/rss.xml
